title: 第86章 动我亲人，就得承受住清算！

content_zh: 柳老夫人站了起来，她很清楚，唐敬和颜霜玉夫妇，最恨的就是她。　　当年是她强势阻拦，才导致颜霜玉没有当上唐家主母，也让唐敬名声扫地。　　现在他们要公报私仇，很正常。　　但只要跪下能救自己的孙子，她是愿意的，因为现在以柳家的关系，竟然连柳文彦为何被羁押都查不出来。　　她怕柳公瑾的案子，连累到柳文彦。　　唐敬自然不会真的让柳老夫人跪下，柳家虽然落魄了，但毕竟曾经辉煌过，朝中有很多人都曾受过其恩惠。　　现在迫于压力，他们可以不管柳家，但要是真让柳老夫人跪下了，那事情可就大了，谁都不想背一个不忠不孝不仁不义的骂名。　　他唐敬养了十几年的好名声，也不想被糟蹋殆尽。　　因此柳老夫人的膝盖没落下，唐敬便连忙将她扶了起来：“娘，你这是干嘛？霜玉开玩笑的，你别和他一般见识。”　　“柳家的事，我是不可能袖手旁观的。”　　说到这里唐家假装面有难色，在原地转了一圈才道：“娘，唐逸和文彦他们这次惹的事有点大，我将唐逸揪出来，花了很大的代价。”　　“要救彦儿，要想太子……要想幻音坊后面的人不追究，可以，拿《书圣帖》来换。”　　听到这话，柳老太太瞳孔微缩，沈氏也苍白下来，姜氏也下意识捂住嘴。　　什么？幻音坊的后面，竟然是太子？　　唐逸和柳文彦他们，竟然得罪了太子？！　　但《书圣帖》，是柳家的传家宝啊！　　“娘，《书圣帖》，是唯一可以救彦儿的东西。”　　唐敬端着茶杯，轻微地晃动：“而且有《书圣帖》做筹码，有太子斡旋，柳公瑾或许还有一线生机……”　　柳公瑾必死无疑，但为了得到《书圣帖》，他还是故意给柳家人留个希望。　　果然，柳老夫人猛地抬起头，盯着唐敬：“你说的可是真的？柳家交出《书圣帖》，你可真能救文彦和公瑾的性命？”　　唐敬见到柳老夫人上当，微微颔首道：“彦儿放回来没有一点问题，公瑾就算不死，恐怕也得流徙两千里。”　　闻言，柳老夫人，沈氏眼中都有了光。　　流放就流放，只要不死，一切就都还有机会。　　姜氏却是脸色铁青，柳家最值钱的就是《书圣帖》，怎么能为了救两个废物，就这样送出去？　　颜霜玉看着已经动摇的柳老夫人和沈氏，嘴角也是冷笑不已。　　呵，老贱人你不是很睿智吗？你不是高高在上吗？原来你也有急的时候？　　这么低级的局，竟然真上当了。　　“好，我这就让人将《书圣帖》带来……”　　《书圣帖》是文坛瑰宝，但和家人性命比起来，根本算不得什么。　　柳老夫人当即便要让沈氏回去取，这时一道带着笑意的声音传来。　　“外婆，唐敬在骗你，你可别上当了。”　　“他，救不了我大舅！”　　众人立即循声望去，就看到唐逸穿着飞鱼服腰挎绣春刀，抱着唐音走了过来。　　“逸儿？音儿？”　　见到唐逸和唐音，柳老夫人瞬间站了起来，手中的手杖都掉在了地上。　　看着唐逸和唐音单薄消瘦的身影，老夫人眼睛当时就红了。　　因为唐家的阻拦，她已经有三四年没有见过这对外孙了，他们这些年得吃多少苦啊！　　“外孙唐逸，拜见外婆。”　　“外孙音音，拜见外婆。”　　走到老夫人的面前，唐逸和唐音便跪了下来，给柳老夫人磕了头。　　“好，好，好孩子，快起来，快起来……”　　柳老夫人红着眼将唐逸和唐音拉了起来，仔细打量了唐逸兄妹，见到唐逸和唐音粗糙不堪的双手，眼泪忍不住流了下来。　　“怎么这么多伤口，手都粗糙成树皮了，你们兄妹俩，这是得遭多大的罪啊！”　　柳老夫人抱着唐逸和唐音，悲痛得身体都在颤抖。　　看着这一幕，沈氏也红着眼抹眼泪，姜氏却只是不屑地撇了撇嘴。　　唐敬和颜霜玉脸色也都阴沉下来，盯着唐逸的目光冰冷无比，原本可以完美结束的骗局，没想到又让唐逸给搅了。　　“外婆，我没事，我们现在已经过得很好了。”　　唐逸双手抓着外婆的手，嘴角带着笑容，鼻子却莫名一阵酸涩。　　“外婆，真的，我哥哥现在可厉害了！”唐音也是扬起小拳头，精致的小脸上满是炫耀。　　“好好好，厉害，厉害。”　　柳老夫人笑着揉了揉唐音的脸，道：“来，快见过你舅妈。”　　“见过大舅妈，二舅妈。”　　唐逸和唐音恭敬行礼，沈氏笑着将他们兄妹俩扶了起来，随即看到唐逸身上的飞鱼服，怔住：“小逸，你……你现在是锦衣卫？”　　“对，我现在是锦衣卫百户。”　　唐逸看向外婆，有些诧异道：“舅妈，外婆，我昨日明明已经让舅舅给你们写了亲笔信报平安，你们怎么还来找唐侍郎？”　　“你们不用求人的，舅舅的案子我已经破了，舅舅已经没事了，过几日就可以回府。”　　听到这话，柳老夫人和沈氏顿时呆住。　　唐敬和颜霜玉也都愣住了。　　柳老夫人抓住唐逸的手，声音都颤抖起来：“小逸，你说的可是真的？你大舅真的没事了？”　　“你别骗外婆，这几日你二舅求了很多人，都说你大舅是公选出来的替罪羊，必死无疑。”　　沈氏也盯着唐逸，死死地攥紧拳头，想说什么又不敢说。　　唐逸看了外婆一眼，又看了一眼沈氏，郑重道：“外婆，舅妈，放心吧，这种事我岂敢开玩笑。”　　“我们一处已经将舅舅的案子查实了，证据也都找到，如今已经呈报给陛下了。”　　“再过几日，陛下估计会亲自传我问案，而我会亲手解开这个案子的谜底的。”　　说到这里，唐逸目光落在唐敬身上，声音凛冽道：“满朝文武想要大舅背锅，想要大舅替他们死。”　　“那是他们想多了！”　　“他们欠下的债，只能由他们亲手还！”　　“我会让他们知道，敢动我亲人……就得承受得住，我的清算！”
content_en: Mrs. Liu stood up. She knew very well that Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu hated her the most.It was her strong obstruction that prevented Yan Shuangyu from becoming the mistress of the Tang family, and also caused Tang Jing's reputation to be tarnished.Now they want to avenge their private vengeance, which is normal.But as long as she could kneel down to save her grandson, she was willing to do so, because with the relationship between the Liu family and her family, she couldn't even find out why Liu Wenyan was detained.She was afraid that Liu Gongjin's case would implicate Liu Wenyan.Naturally, Tang Jing would not really ask Mrs. Liu to kneel down. Although the Liu family was in decline, it had once been glorious, and many people in the court had benefited from it.Now under pressure, they can leave the Liu family alone, but if Mrs. Liu really gets down on her knees, it will be a big deal. No one wants to be accused of being unfaithful, unfilial, and unkind.He, Tang Jing, had cultivated a good reputation for more than ten years and did not want it to be ruined.Therefore, before Mrs. Liu's knees fell, Tang Jing quickly helped her up: "Mother, what are you doing? Shuang Yu is joking, don't be as familiar with him." "I can't stand by and watch the Liu family's affairs." At this point, the Tang family pretended to be embarrassed, and turned around in a circle before saying, "Mother, Tang YiheWen Yan and the others caused a big trouble this time, and I spent a lot of money to get Tang Yi out.""If you want to save Yan'er, if you want the prince... If you want the people behind Huanyinfang not to pursue it, you can exchange it for the "Shu Sheng Tie"." Upon hearing this, Mrs. Liu's pupils shrank, Mrs. Shen also turned pale, and Mrs. Jiang subconsciously covered her mouth.What?Behind Huanyinfang, is the prince?Tang Yi and Liu Wenyan actually offended the prince?!But "Shu Sheng Tie" is an heirloom of the Liu family!"Mom, the "Shu Sheng Tie" is the only thing that can save Yan'er." Tang Jing held the tea cup and shook it slightly: "And with the "Shu Sheng Tie" as a bargaining chip and the prince's mediation, Liu Gongjin may still have a chance of survival..." Liu Gongjin was bound to die, but in order to get the "Shu Sheng Tie", he deliberately left a hope for the Liu family.Sure enough, Mrs. Liu suddenly raised her head and stared at Tang Jing: "Are you telling the truth? If the Liu family hands over the "Book of Saints", can you really save the lives of Wen Yan and Gong Jin?" Tang Jing saw LiuThe old lady was fooled, she nodded slightly and said, "There will be no problem in bringing Yan'er back. Even if Gong Jin doesn't die, I'm afraid he will have to move two thousand miles away." Hearing this, Mrs. Liu and Mr. Shen's eyes lighted up.Exile means exile. As long as you don't die, there is still a chance for everything.Ms. Jiang's face was livid. The most valuable thing in the Liu family was the "Book of Saints". How could you give it away like this just to save two losers?Yan Shuangyu looked at the shaken Mrs. Liu and Mr. Shen, with a sneer on her lips.Hehe, old bitch, aren’t you very wise?Aren't you superior?It turns out that you are also in a hurry?Such a low-level game, I actually got fooled."Okay, I'll ask someone to bring "The Holy Book of Letters"..." "The Holy Book of Letters" is a treasure in the literary world, but compared with the lives of family members, it is nothing at all.Mrs. Liu was about to ask Shen to go back and get it, when a smiling voice came."Grandma, Tang Jing is lying to you, don't be fooled." "He can't save my uncle!" Everyone immediately followed the sound and saw Tang Yi wearing a flying fish suit with an embroidered spring knife on his waist, walking over with Tang Yin in his arms."Yi'er? Yin'er?" Seeing Tang Yi and Tang Yin, Mrs. Liu stood up instantly and dropped the cane in her hand.Looking at the thin and thin figures of Tang Yi and Tang Yin, the old lady's eyes turned red.Because of the Tang family's obstruction, she has not seen the grandsons for three or four years. How much hardship they have endured over the years!"My grandson, Tang Yi, pays homage to grandma." "My grandson, Yinyin, pays homage to grandma." Walking in front of the old lady, Tang Yi and Tang Yin knelt down and kowtowed to Mrs. Liu."Okay, okay, good boy, get up, get up..." Mrs. Liu pulled Tang Yi and Tang Yin up with red eyes, carefully looked at the Tang Yi brothers and sisters, and couldn't help but shed tears when she saw Tang Yi and Tang Yin's rough hands."Why are there so many wounds? My hands are as rough as bark. You two brothers and sisters must have suffered so much!" Madam Liu held Tang Yi and Tang Yin in her arms, her body trembling with grief.Seeing this scene, Mrs. Shen also wiped her tears with red eyes, but Ms. Jiang just curled her lips in disdain.Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu's expressions also darkened, and they stared at Tang Yi with extremely cold eyes. The scam that could have ended perfectly was unexpectedly messed up by Tang Yi again."Grandma, I'm fine. We are living a good life now." Tang Yi held his grandma's hand with both hands, with a smile on his lips, but his nose felt inexplicably sour."Grandma, it's true, my brother is so awesome now!" Tang Yin also raised his fist, his delicate little face full of showoff."Okay, okay, awesome, awesome." Old Mrs. Liu smiled and rubbed Tang Yin's face and said, "Come on, I'll meet your aunt soon." "I've met my eldest aunt and my second aunt." Tang Yi and Tang Yin saluted respectfully. Mrs. Shen smiled and helped the two brothers up. Then she saw the flying fish suit on Tang Yi's body and was stunned: "Xiao Yi, you...are you a Jin Yiwei now?" "Yes, I am now.This is Jinyiwei Baihu." Tang Yi looked at grandma and said with some surprise: "Aunt, grandma, I asked uncle to write a personal letter to you yesterday, why do you still come to see Mr. Tang?" "You don't need to ask for help.I have solved my uncle's case and he is fine.He can return to the house in a few days." Upon hearing this, Mrs. Liu and Mrs. Shen were stunned.Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu were also stunned.Madam Liu grabbed Tang Yi's hand and her voice trembled: "Xiao Yi, are you telling the truth? Is your uncle really okay?" "Don't lie to grandma, your second uncle has begged many people in the past few days, saying that your uncle is the scapegoat chosen by the public and will definitely die." Mrs. Shen also stared at Tang Yi, clenching her fists tightly, but she didn't dare to say what she wanted to say.Tang Yi glanced at grandma, then at Mrs. Shen, and said solemnly: "Grandma, aunt, don't worry, I dare not joke about this kind of thing."
